correctness.rationale: For n>=5, the H-fixed invariant circulation proof uses three vertex orbits and reversibility of intraorbit edges; the remaining A-D and D-F amplitudes vanish by divergence. This proves unique invariant projections and, by finite-group averaging, global minimality. The exact zero-mean vertex potential has values ±a, ±b, 0 and satisfies Laplacian phi=delta_u-delta_v for every n by symbolic neighbor counts. Five explicitly exhaustive edge classes give the cut norm; the diagonal response gives the complementary cycle norm. An independently assembled exact-rational checker from the package validates every column for n=3..9; finite checks do not establish the unrestricted result.

value.rationale: The finite-dimensional relative projection constants of graph cut/circulation subspaces are natural Banach-space invariants motivating the cited 2023 cycle-space paper. This theorem settles both complementary invariants for the entire nontrivial line-graph-of-cliques family J(n,2), with explicit rational sharp constants, a non-obvious symmetry obstruction proving global (not merely invariant) optimality, and distinct limiting constants 3 and 4. The n=4 balanced multipartite boundary is deliberately excluded; this is not merely a special-case computation.
